title: Enweghị Nsọ
intro: E wezụga ájá oge ochie, e nwere akụkọ banyere nraranye na ntụkwasị obi siri ike nke na mkpụrụ obi bu ya gaara emebi. N'oge ndị mmadụ tụgharịrị gaa n'ihe nzuzu na ọlaedo, otu onye guzosiri ike—na-akpọghachi ha azụ, na-arịọ maka ndidi, ma na-ebu ibu arọ nke nkwa dị nsọ. Nke a bụ akụkọ nke onye a họpụtara dị ka onye enyemaka, onye nlekọta, na onye nche okwukwe n'oge ọnụnọ dị nsọ. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta njirimara nke mkpụrụ obi a siri ike?
clues: M na-ekerịta ọbara nke onye amụma ukwu a họpụtara ka ọ gwa Allah okwu kpọmkwem n'elu ugwu dị nsọ.
Nwanne m nwoke rịọrọ Allah maka enyemaka iji gwa onye mmegbu dị ukwuu okwu nke ọma.
Allah họpụtara m ka m guzoro n'akụkụ nwanne m nwoke dịka onye enyemaka na onye nlekọta.
Anyị zutere otu onye ọchịchị aka ike nke kwuru ka a kpọọ ya chi kachasị elu.
Mgbe nwanne m nwoke na Allah na-akparịta ụka n'elu ugwu ahụ, ndị anyị kpụrụ onwe ha arụsị site na ọlaedo ha.
Abụ m nwanne Mozis, nke Allah họpụtara dịka onye nlekọta ya, aha m kpọkwara aha ya na Quran.
arabic: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَجَعَلْنَا مَعَهُۥٓ أَخَاهُ هَـٰرُونَ وَزِيرًۭا
verse: And We had certainly given Moses the Scripture and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant. (25:35)
